text: Travel experiences can be exciting and life-changing. When planning a trip, it is important to research the destination, book accommodation early, and make a budget. Travelling allows you to experience new cultures, try delicious local food, and meet people from different backgrounds. However, language barriers can sometimes cause problems, so learning a few basic phrases is always useful. Despite small challenges, every journey creates unforgettable memories that stay with you forever. Whether you travel alone or with friends, each trip teaches you something new about the world and about yourself.
